messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick heads up — I noticed on the April 2 payroll run that Lila A's paystub shows both US federal withholding and Irish PAYE taken. She moved to IE effective 2026-04-01; payroll vendor might have processed the change mid-cycle. Can payroll confirm?

alex-payroll: Thanks Maria — seeing the same. Run ID: payrun_20260402_8421 (from payroll-bot). Looks like change of resident country was submitted 2026-04-01 09:18am UTC, after the cut for this run.

payroll-bot: Automated note: payrun_20260402_8421 (closed) — employee Lila A (EMP-10987) net pay adjusted. Files: stub_10987_2026-04-02.pdf.

lila: Hey — yep i updated my relocation paperwork on 4/1, didn't realize it would still hit this run. Net pay was ~€1,900 less than expected. :(

ross-eng: Oh no — that's the bonus month for my team. Lila, want me to escalate to finance?

alex-payroll: Please do. Preliminary root cause: vendor accepted the country change but flagged it as "post-cut" for payroll_8421. System created both US withholding lines and IE PAYE because tax residency switched in the middle of the period, so both engines applied.

alex-payroll: Snippet from the paystub for clarity:
```
Gross pay: 5,200.00 USD
Federal tax (US): -1,040.00 USD
State tax (CA): -156.00 USD
Employee NI / PRSI (IE PAYE conversion): -930.00 USD (converted)
Net pay: 3,074.00 USD
Note: dual-country withholdings applied due to mid-cycle residency flag.
```

maria-peopleops: Yikes. What's the remediation path? We need Lila made whole ASAP and record corrections for year-end (W-2 / Irish P60) if needed. Also need to capture ledger impact for reserved budget.

alex-payroll: Plan: 1) Run a retro adjustment payroll to refund the duplicate US withholdings (taxable gross unchanged), target next payroll off-cycle (expedite). 2) Coordinate with vendor to mark 4/1 as residence effective date so future runs only apply IE PAYE. 3) Prepare documentation for W-2 amendment (W-2c) and Irish end-of-year forms (P60/P45 notes) — tax treatment team to confirm foreign tax credit guidance.

finance-ledger: @alex-payroll please tag the GL codes for the retro so we can book accruals. We need the estimated gross and employer tax pickup for month-end close.

alex-payroll: Will do. Estimated adjustment (gross unaffected): refund of US withholdings ~1,196.00 USD + employer SS/med ~231.00 USD. I'll attach a calc.csv in the vendor ticket.

maria-peopleops: Lila, sorry for the disruption. We'll push the refund ASAP and follow up once vendor confirms the retro. Expect an off-cycle payment and an official correction note. :heart:

lila: Thank you — appreciate the quick responses. Do I need to file anything on my side for the hybrid month?

alex-payroll: Mostly vendor/bookkeeping side. We may ask you to confirm the IE PPSN and provide any pay documentation for the tax team. I'll DM the list.

ross-eng: Let us know if you need a headcount/bonus hold to be released once sorted.

alex-payroll: Tagging vendor ticket #VND-5491 for visibility. I'll update here when the off-cycle posts or if we need a W-2c request.

payroll-bot: Ticket VND-5491 created and assigned to payroll-vendor. Estimated vendor ETA: 48-72h.

maria-peopleops: Great. Please include a short blurb for Lila's file that notes the mid-pay-period residency change and the correction steps so we have audit trail. Closing loop once off-cycle posts.

alex-payroll: Will add the audit note and cc @finance-ledger. Will update in ~48h or sooner.

lila: Thanks everyone!

maria-peopleops: Thanks — keeping this thread pinned until resolved. :spiral_note_pad:
